<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2007|month=01|day=24|content=

* In a speech at [[Brandeis University]], former [[United States President]] [[Jimmy Carter]] apologizes for the wording of a sentence in his recently published book, ''[[Palestine: Peace Not Apartheid]]''. He referred to the wording as "stupid" and subsequent reprintings will change it.  Despite the book's controversy, the audience received him with a standing ovation. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070527210756/http://www.jta.org/page_view_breaking_story.asp?intid=6567&ref=daily_briefing (JTA)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20070128021706/http://www.jta.org/page_view_story.asp?intarticleid=17510&intcategoryid=4 (JTA)]
* Thomas Lepoutre announced his gay pride movement today
* [[Ecuador|Ecuador's]] Defense Minister [[Guadalupe Larriva]] is killed along with three pilots and her daughter in a crash involving two helicopters. Larriva was the first woman to serve as the country's defense minister. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/americas/6297093.stm (BBC)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20070216050529/http://today.reuters.com/news/articlenews.aspx?type=newsOne (Reuters)]
* [[India]] and [[Russia]] agree to jointly develop [[4th generation jet fighter#5th generation aircraft|fifth-generation stealth fighter jets]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070929094301/http://www.turkishweekly.net/news.php?id=42250 (ISRO)]
* Over 100,000 Turkish citizens, including those of [[Armenians in Turkey|Armenian]] descent fill the streets of [[Istanbul]] to mourn and mark the assassination of [[Hrant Dink]], editor of the dissident newspaper ''[[Agos]]''. * [[War in Somalia (2006–2009)|War in Somalia]]: The [[Military of the United States|U.S. military]] conducts another air strike against supposed [[al-Qaeda]] operatives in [[Somalia]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070216050529/http://today.reuters.com/news/articlenews.aspx?type=newsOne (Reuters)]
* A [[Sudan|Sudanese]] airliner, [[Air West Flight 612]], carrying 103 people, is [[aircraft hijacking|hijacked]] by a lone gunman and diverted to [[N'Djamena]], [[Chad]]. The [[Air West]] flight lands at the airport in N'Djamena and the hijacker is arrested.
